AcademyAI (GB, GBP 1.65M pre-seed) measures employee AI capability and trains the gaps. The signal's own CZ check names a dated Czech driver — Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI literacy of staff), in force since 2 Feb 2025 — and finds the TRAINING half taken by established Czech providers (TAYLLORCOX, Skrivanek, PwC's AI Act academy) while no Czech vendor sells the MEASUREMENT layer. Not p-0034: that record is Article 50 transparency (chatbot and synthetic-content disclosure) sold as a website scan to small firms; AI literacy is a different duty, a different product and a different buyer need, and folding it in would broaden the record past its own title and solution. Flagged as a NEW-PROBLEM candidate, not created: 'AI literacy duty — Czech employers must ensure staff AI literacy under AI Act Art 4; courses are sold, capability measurement is not'. Caveat the signal itself records: the epravo analysis says the AI Act does not require measuring knowledge or a certificate, so the measurement half is recommended practice, not a mandate — a record built on it could not score urgency on measurement.
